specification_semantics.target_formula: 2 * rank(method='average', pct=True) - 1 within each training date
specification_semantics.target_note: For an untied cross-section of size n, the minimum is 2/n - 1 and the daily mean is 1/n. The evaluated formula remains unchanged.
specification_semantics.preprocessing_weights: SimpleImputer and StandardScaler are row-weighted; date-equal sample weights apply only to the Ridge loss. A date-weighted preprocessing variant requires separate forward registration.

stage_1_zero_base_screen.conclusion: All six engineered single-feature additions failed their predeclared robustness screen. A daily cross-sectional percentile target fitted with Ridge was the only initial candidate with positive net20, nonnegative net40, and positive top5-removed net20.

decision.reason: after this audit, stop retrospective target/model tuning because no unused outcome remains

stage_4_fixed_role_confirmation.conclusion: The fixed L4 and L6 roles reproduced, but neither uplift over L0 survived the 15-candidate max-statistic adjustment. Roles are descriptive shadow roles, not statistically demonstrated improvements or production promotions.

robustness.features: base 15 plus no_trade_rate_20, no_trade_rate_60, flat_oc_rate_20, zero_range_rate_20

interpretation.mean_return_role: L4 is retained because it has the largest retrospective net20 and positive net40.
interpretation.robustness_role: L6 is retained because dominant-code share is lower and net20 remains positive after removing 20 best days.
interpretation.not_a_liquidity_penalty: The G5 standardized coefficients are mostly positive. These proxies are selection signals correlated with illiquidity, not learned penalties.
interpretation.economic_limit: Both finalists turn negative at 60 bp; L4 loses positive median by 40 bp, while L6 median remains barely positive. Executability is unresolved.

reproduction_audits.fold_definition: 13 calendar-month walk-forward folds; each fit uses only rows dated before the scoring month

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Direct binary up/down probability is the right target.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: The expanding raked logistic baseline returned -0.378844% net20; top-decile classifiers were also negative.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Expected raw return or downside-penalized raw return is the right target.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: Daily-centered Ridge, Huber, two-part expected return, downside-penalized, and relevance-weighted raw-return variants failed the screen.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Within-day cross-sectional return percentile is a more stable ranking target.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: Daily rank Ridge was positive at 20 and 40 bp, across all four time blocks, and after removal of the five best days.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Six new nonlinear feature transforms improve the logistic baseline.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: FZ1-FZ6 all failed the predeclared robustness screen; FZ2 had positive point uplift but a negative 80% lower bound and only two positive blocks.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Stronger Ridge shrinkage or fixed training improves rank-target robustness.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: Alpha=10/100 and fixed-pre-July variants were weaker; expanding alpha=1 was retained.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Availability/liquidity proxies should be hard candidate exclusions.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: Training-only quantile screens materially reduced returns. The archive cannot verify actual executable liquidity.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: flat_oc_rate_20 adds mean-return information to the rank model.
hypothesis_decisions.evidence: L4 net20 rose by 0.027871 percentage points versus L0 in all four blocks, but the max-statistic-adjusted 80% lower uplift was -0.094078.
L6 reduced largest-code share to 22.07% and retained +0.017913% after removing 20 best days, but adjusted uplift over L0 was not positive and proxy coefficients were mostly positive.

binding_limitations: All frozen-panel outcomes were previously visible; there is no sealed holdout for promotion.
The archive lacks historical turnover, volume, trading unit, bid-ask spread, and observed execution cost.
Exact 08:58 futures, indicative-open, board and PTS snapshots are absent.
Retrospective mean uplift is not family-wise significant after the 15-candidate max-statistic adjustment.
Performance is dependent on illiquid-looking names and is negative at 60 bp round-trip cost.
Date-equal weights affect only the Ridge loss; imputation and standardization remain row-weighted in the evaluated specification.
TDnet/disclosure content is evaluated in a separate research track and is not silently imputed into this panel.

stop_decision.why_no_more_same_panel_search: Additional variants would reuse already-viewed outcomes and increase selection bias without resolving execution uncertainty.
next_valid_evidence: shadow-score sessions from 2026-07-23 onward under the frozen specifications
content-addressed point-in-time liquidity and exact 08:58 market snapshots
a separately registered TDnet-content join with explicit publication timestamps and missingness
